records.topic: Wiring diagram: components and wire colour code
records.statement: Beta's electrical diagram for the 2021 RX 300 shows: Engine stop button, Second map switch, Start button, Voltage regulator, Starter motor, 10a fuse, Starter relay, Battery positive terminal, Lithium 12v 2ah battery, Battery negative terminal, Frame earth wire, Diodes group, Condensator 4700 µF, Generator, Pick-up sensor, Electronic control unit, Ignition coil, Spark plug, Frame earth. Beta's wire colour letters are Italian: Bi white, Ve green, Ma brown, Vi purple, Bl blue, Ne black, Gi yellow, Rs red, Ar orange, Az sky blue, Ro pink, Gr gray. Two together mean base colour and stripe.

ECU pinout on the 2024-2026 RX 450 (pin, wire colour, where it goes): 2 gray/blue and 19 gray/red, actuators relay and diagnostic side; 3 blue/black, sensor ground; 4 green and 14 red, pick-up; 6 yellow/blue, throttle position signal; 7 white/brown, temperature sensor; 9 white/pink, rollover sensor; 11 black, ground; 12 white/green and 24 yellow/white, T-MAP sensor signals; 13 green/red, 17 yellow, 18 orange/black and 28 white, stepper motor; 15 pink/purple, MIL warning light; 16 white/black, engine stop button; 20 gray/green and 36 yellow/red, second map switch; 21 brown/blue, gear sensor; 22 yellow/black and 34 yellow/pink, diagnostic connector; 23 gray, sensor supply; 25 gray/black, battery feed; 27 pink, injector; 29 red/blue, fuel pump; 30 green/black, generator connector; 35 white/red, ignition coil.
records.notes: Read from the wiring diagram by eye; check the diagram on the bike before cutting, splicing or back-probing. Pin jobs are inferred from where each wire runs on the diagram.

records.statement: Wire colours on the 2024-2026 RX 450. Sensors share a gray supply wire and a blue/black ground. Throttle position sensor: blue/black, yellow/blue signal, gray. T-MAP (pressure and air temperature) sensor: blue/black, yellow/white, white/green, gray. Temperature sensor: white/brown and gray. Rollover sensor: gray, white/pink and blue/black. Gear sensor: brown/blue, blue/black and gray. Pick-up: red and green. Injector: pink (ECU) and blue (power). Ignition coil: white/red (ECU) and blue (power). Fuel pump: blue/red and blue. Stepper motor on the throttle body: green/red, white, orange/black and yellow. Engine stop button: white/black to black (ground). Second map switch: yellow/red, blue and gray/green. Start button: gray/black and white/orange.
records.notes: Read from the wiring diagram by eye; check the diagram on the bike before cutting, splicing or back-probing.

records.statement: Power on the 2024-2026 RX 450: the stator sends two wires to the voltage regulator (white on the regulator side); the regulator's output is gray/black and its ground black. Gray/black is the battery positive feed throughout the bike, and it also runs to the 4,700 µF condenser, the start button, the MIL light and the actuators relay. The actuators relay switches power onto the blue wire that feeds the ignition coil, injector and fuel pump. The battery is a 12 V 2 Ah lithium unit with a 10 A fuse at the starter relay; the start button triggers the relay on white/orange. Black is ground. The MIL warning light sits in series with a 470 ohm resistor on pink/purple.
records.notes: Read from the wiring diagram by eye; check the diagram on the bike before cutting, splicing or back-probing.
